mostWorthwhile.text: The quiet scene in the receiving laboratory was the most worthwhile passage: the second pair of hands and the shared silence give the discovery weight without explaining too much.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final board felt unnecessary because there were no goals or actions to take.

surprise.text: The ending moves directly from orbit to the receiving laboratory, leaving the return journey undescribed.

arbitrary.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to assess for arbitrariness.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because I am curious what the laboratory might learn from the body and its surrounding ice, though this ending also feels complete.
